style.backgroundSystem: cinematic dark gradient #0D0F12 to #2B2E33 for hero and scene shots, clean white #FFFFFF and light grey #F4F5F7 for infographic shots, one electric blue accent panel #2A7BFF reserved for the closing shot
style.iconSystem: thin-line callout labels and small square info chips in the single accent color
style.lightingSystem: cool directional studio key with controlled speculars on steel and soft contact shadows, 5500K natural window light in lifestyle shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark cinematic fitness equipment visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cinematic dark gradient #0D0F12, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one electric blue accent #2A7BFF; cool directional studio lighting with controlled highlights on steel and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif metallic silver short bold headlines with small electric-blue sub-lines; consistent thin-line callout labels and small square info chips in the accent color; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with perfectly straight steel lines and clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped or bent frame lines.
noDrift: no warped or bent frame lines
style.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle and scale for full-product shots; all steel tubes and pad edges must stay perfectly straight
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark studio floor, textured dark rubber gym matting, brushed dark steel
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, metallic silver short bold headlines with a small electric-blue sub-line
